messages:
elaine: quick flag 10k session events in us-east lost session_id for ~2026-03-01T08:10-08:40. retention/dashboard charts show a dip for daily active sessions.
ryan: how does session_id get dropped? upstream change in sessionizer?
neel: looks like a schema evolution in the sessionizer lambda. it started writing event.session_id as empty string when session_context was null. downstream join job treats empty string as valid key so counts are off.
ci-ops-bot: deploy-tracker: sessionizer-v2 deployed at 2026-03-01T08:05 in us-east.
harpreet: can we reconstruct session_id by joining on device_id + approximate timestamp window? risk of collisions but probably ok for DAU-level aggregates.
elaine: my concern: if we do an aggressive heuristic we might over-attribute and inflate metrics. product will notice.
kate: console team here 10 we should show a subtle banner on affected charts rather than full outage modal. copy suggestion: "Partial recompute in progress for sessions (ETA ~90m). Numbers may change."
ryan: agree banner. for the fix: two options: 1) targeted replay + heuristic reattach job that sets session_id for events where missing, or 2) recompute aggregates using event-based sessionization (re-run aggregation without relying on session_id). option 2 is heavier but safer.
neel: option 2 means re-running session-aggregate pipeline for the time window across all shards -> expensive (~3h at normal capacity). We could do option 2 but gated to 15% compute for 3h.
harpreet: option 1 heuristic: join events -> session_starts on device_id within +-30m, assign start.session_id. We already use similar fallback in nightly backfills. implementation is fast and idempotent if we tag writes with backfill_id. downside: any long-running sessions might get mis-split.
elaine: metrics sensitivity: product asked for <0.5% diff from truth. which option keeps us within that?
neel: empirical: heuristic had 0.7% error in last test. recompute-based approach had 0.03% error.
kate: product will prefer accuracy, but cost team will push back on compute. maybe run heuristic first, surface badge, then run recompute async at low priority if diffs >0.5%.
ryan: that seems pragmatic. schedule: heuristic replay now, then recompute overnight as low-priority window if needed.
ci-ops-bot: backfill-scheduler: tentative job queued if approved.
elaine: ok can we scope heuristic to tenant set T1,T3 only? they account for 92% of the DAU dip. leave the rest for recompute.
neel: yes. parameters: tenant_ids=[T1,T3], time_window='2026-03-01T08:10:00Z'..'2026-03-01T08:40:00Z', heuristic_window=30m, backfill_id=session-mend-20260301. dedupe=true.
harpreet: routing: route to recon-lane with concurrency=8 and cpu-quota=12% to limit impact. we can bump to 25% for first 20m if it's starving.
kate: enabling banner via feature flag console.recompute_banner.session_missing, flag value tenant_whitelist=[T1,T3] and message as above.
ryan: can someone run the safety query to estimate cardinality we'd touch?
elle: I ran a quick count:
```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM telemetry.events
WHERE session_id = '' AND region = 'us-east' AND created_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-01 08:10:00' AND '2026-03-01 08:40:00' AND tenant_id IN ('T1','T3');
-- result: 10432
```
neel: good. that's small. go for heuristic.
ci-ops-bot: backfill-runner: job queued -> id=job-20260301-0023 tag=session-mend-20260301 owner=neel
neel: starting job job-20260301-0023 now. shard progress log: `shard=3 processed=220 assigned=4200 errs=0`
harpreet: monitoring: queuing delay staying under 200ms. CPU quota holding. I'll watch for increased lag on realtime merges.
kate: badge enabled for T1/T3. copying the exact banner to product: "Partial recompute in progress for sessions (ETA ~45m) 10 numbers will update when replay completes."
elaine: action items recap: neel -> run heuristic job and tag outputs, harpreet -> enforce routing/quota, kate -> show banner + flag, ryan -> draft incident note for product & finance impact.
neel: mid-run update: 3/12 shards done, processed=3600 reattached=3037 ambiguous=18 (logged for manual review).
ryan: ambiguous cases 10 we should surface count of ambiguous to product as part of note.
ci-ops-bot: backfill-runner: job-job-20260301-0023 completed. processed=10432 reattached=10112 ambiguous=320 errs=0
aleine: typo in my username earlier.
aleine: final reconciliation: aggregates for tenants T1/T3 back within expected ranges (delta <0.4%). scheduling low-priority full recompute overnight to get to <0.05% accuracy. disabling priority bump.
kate: product updated. banner will be auto-remove after recompute completes (flag toggled).
neel: follow-up PR to sessionizer: add schema guard to avoid writing empty session_id and emit metrics when session_context null. I'll open PR and tag @ryan for review.
ryan: thanks. postmortem stub created -> /incidents/2026-03-01-session-mend-draft.md
kate: nice coordination everyone.
